mobbin:8fee942f-3bba-4b19-949e-9011dfee6.summary: User opens Share, drills into link settings, turns on expiration + password + disable-downloads, saves, and returns to the share sheet with restrictions acknowledged.
steps: Share sheet · Settings saved · Restrictions apply
steal: Steps 1–2: separate tabs for 'Link for editing' vs 'Link for viewing' so download/view policy is not conflated with edit rights.
Steps 2–7: stacked toggles — Expiration (date), Require password, Disable downloads — each off by default until needed.
Step 7: yellow scope warning 'This applies only within Dropbox' when disable-downloads is on — honest limit disclosure.
Step 8: after save, share sheet shows 'Restrictions apply · Modify' under Copy link plus a 'Settings saved' toast.
avoid: Nine screens of nearly identical settings UI for one config job — Essentials should keep expiry/password/download on one compact panel, not a long toggle walkthrough.
mobbin:8fee942f-3bba-4b19-949e-9011dfee6.fit: Directly extends Baseline expiring learner share links: password + disable-downloads + post-save 'restrictions apply' cue; still needs an explicit download consent step for identifiable sim video.
